observations: Two car headlights are shown side-by-side on a green surface.
The headlights have a modern, angular design with clear lenses and amber turn signal sections.
The housing appears to be made of plastic with some visible wear and minor scratches.
The top headlight has a slightly different shape and angle compared to the bottom one.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the housing or lenses.
The seller claims they are for a Corolla 2014-2015, but no model-specific features are visible to confirm.
The seller also claims they are 'original' and 'direct from the car'.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers on the headlights to confirm compatibility with Corolla 2014-2015. The design is modern and could be from multiple models.
No proof of origin or source; cannot verify if they are genuine or salvaged parts.
Price is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as incompatible or for a different model, reducing value.

risks.proof: Video or photo showing the headlights turned on, or close-up of the bulb sockets and wiring harness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: Headlights may be counterfeit or non-original
risks.proof: Photo of the part number or serial number on the back of the headlights, or a comparison with a genuine Corolla 2014-2015 headlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the headlights showing any part numbers or model identifiers.
Video or photo of the headlights turned on to confirm functionality.
Photo showing the mounting points and lens shape to confirm fit for Corolla 2014-2015.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
